main_radius = main_diameter / 2.0
reduced_radius = reduced_diameter / 2.0
tip_radius = tip_diameter / 2.0

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            Polyline((0, 0), (main_radius, 0), (main_radius, main_body_length),
                     (reduced_radius, main_body_length + reduced_section_length),
                     (tip_radius, total_length - tip_length),
                     (0, total_length), close=True)
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Y)

solid_body = p.part
top_face = solid_body.faces().sort_by(Axis.Y)[-1]
solid_body = chamfer(top_face.edges(), chamfer_size)

part = solid_body
part.name = "stepped_shaft"
export_step(part, "output.step")
